overview: 1945 list of papers records a 1939 Taihoku report on Taiwan's extended jurisdiction over the Shinnan Gunto (Spratly Islands).

people.name: Gerald Warner
people.role: U.S. diplomatic or consular officer associated with the April 1, 1939 communication from Taihoku

subfiles.title: Department of State list of papers on Formosa and the Shinnan Gunto
subfiles.about: This filing sheet inventories a 1939 communication concerning the Taiwan Government-General’s jurisdiction over the Shinnan Gunto in the South China Sea.
subfiles.summary: Lists a 1939 Taihoku communication (Warner) reporting Taiwan's Government-General gained jurisdiction over the Shinnan Gunto, now called the Spratlys.

interest: Tracks Taiwan's 1939 jurisdiction claim over the Spratly Islands.
